technical_and_design_decisions: Target platform is a Spring XD-style distributed runtime with custom modules packaged as uber-jars; baseline is Spring Framework 6 on Java 17 per the specification.

U2: Host custom module uber-jars in a dedicated HDFS directory (e.g., /xd/modules) accessed via the Hadoop HDFS client; newly arriving containers resolve and download modules from HDFS into a local cache before classloading.
U3: Implement the WebSocket sink as a native sink module built on spring-websocket, exposing full-duplex channels over a single TCP connection with configurable port, path, and message codecs.

U8: Shared dependencies are placed under xd/lib and loaded by a shared parent classloader; modules requiring conflicting versions must embed those jars in their uber-jar to isolate them from the shared classloader.

U4/U5: CI builds remain Gradle-based via the Gradle wrapper (./gradlew); the Artifactory Gradle plugin task is replaced by a command task; npm-cache is evaluated and, if adopted, integrated to cache Node dependencies.
U6: Static analysis is centralized in SonarQube with quality gates; committer notifications are configured through SonarQube/CI hooks tied to the commit author.

U7: Windows integration tests run on a Bamboo agent on the existing Bamboo Windows server using PowerShell scripts; required services (Redis, RabbitMQ) are installed as Windows services and started by the CI task.
Testing approach: unit tests with JUnit, integration tests against embedded/minicluster Hadoop where feasible, plus end-to-end CI validation jobs on EC2 and Windows.
assumptions: A single developer performs all work; estimates are in ideal workdays (8 hours each) and represent effort, not elapsed calendar time.
An existing Spring XD-like codebase with module deployment, containers, and the xd/lib directory already exists and is the baseline for this increment.
Access to an HDFS cluster (or Hadoop minicluster for tests), EC2 CI infrastructure, a Bamboo server with a Windows agent, and PowerShell is already available without procurement effort.
npm-cache is relevant only to portions of the build that use npm (front-end assets); the evaluation will confirm applicability before adoption.
The WebSocket sink is a stream sink module only; no user interface work is required.
Documentation (U1) is delivered as markdown/asciidoc within the project repository, including module packaging, HDFS deployment, and xd/lib guidance.
U8 requires implementing/verifying shared xd/lib loading behavior plus documented guidance for version conflicts, not a redesign of the module classloader.
Existing test suites are functional; effort includes fixing only the PMD/Sonar violations related to the WARN log increase, not a full codebase cleanup.
Infrastructure accounts, licenses, and credentials (SonarQube, Artifactory, Bamboo, cloud) are pre-provisioned.

activities.activity_description: Write developer-facing documentation describing recommended standards and patterns for building custom modules, including project layout, packaging as uber-jar, and references to xd/lib and HDFS deployment.

activities.activity_name: Design and implement HDFS hosting of module uber-jars (U2)
activities.activity_description: Implement HDFS-based storage for custom module uber-jars: directory layout, upload/publish path, configuration properties, and module metadata handling using the Hadoop HDFS client.

activities.activity_name: Implement module deployment to newly arriving containers (U2)
activities.activity_description: Implement resolution and distribution of modules from HDFS to newly arriving containers, including local caching, version handling, and integration with the module classloading lifecycle.

activities.activity_name: Test HDFS module hosting and deployment (U2)
activities.activity_description: Write and execute unit and integration tests for HDFS hosting and container deployment, using a Hadoop minicluster where appropriate, and verify failure/retry scenarios.
Design and implement the WebSocket sink module on spring-websocket, providing full-duplex communication over a single TCP connection with configurable endpoint, port, and message handling.
Write and run unit and integration tests for the WebSocket sink, covering connection lifecycle, concurrent clients, message delivery, and error handling.
Spike npm-cache and comparable caching options, assess applicability to the current build, and produce a recommendation for improving CI build stability and reliability.

activities.activity_name: Integrate selected caching option into CI build (U4)
activities.activity_description: Implement and validate the chosen caching solution (e.g., npm-cache) in the CI build so dependencies are reused across builds instead of being downloaded each time.

activities.activity_name: Enable distributed JVM tests on EC2 CI (U5)
activities.activity_description: Configure and validate distributed JVM test execution in the EC2 CI infrastructure.

activities.activity_name: Replace Artifactory Gradle task with wrapper command task (U5)
activities.activity_description: Change CI build configuration from the Artifactory Gradle task to a command task that invokes ./gradlew, and update publishing steps accordingly.

activities.activity_name: Run CI tests with embedded Hadoop disabled (U5)
activities.activity_description: Adjust test configuration to run with embedded Hadoop off, fix resulting test/environment issues, and verify suite stability.
Turn on maxParallelForks for Gradle test execution, tune fork counts for EC2 agents, and confirm build time and stability improvements.
Run full commit-triggered builds on EC2 with all U5 changes applied and confirm reliable execution and functional assertions.
Analyze build/test logs to identify root causes of the increased WARN entries and map them to PMD/Sonar violations.
Remediate the identified PMD and Sonar violations in the codebase and verify that WARN output returns to expected levels.
Configure SonarQube/CI notification rules so that the committer responsible for new violations is automatically notified.

activities.activity_name: Provision Windows Bamboo environment and PowerShell access (U7)
activities.activity_description: Gain access to the existing Bamboo Windows environment, configure the agent, and verify PowerShell execution capabilities for CI tasks.
Set up required services (Redis, RabbitMQ, and similar) on the Windows CI environment with automated start/stop scripts.

activities.activity_name: Create Windows integration test CI task (U7)
activities.activity_description: Implement the Bamboo CI task that runs integration tests on Windows automatically on commit-triggered builds.

activities.activity_name: Stabilize and validate Windows CI runs (U7)
activities.activity_description: Execute repeated Windows CI runs, fix environment-specific failures, and confirm consistent automated integration test results.
Implement/verify support for placing jars shared by two or more modules under xd/lib, including classloader behavior and documented guidance for bundling conflicting versions inside module uber-jars.
Test multi-module deployments using xd/lib, including shared jars and modules bundling older/newer versions to work around classloader conflicts.

activities.activity_name: Increment integration, regression testing, and release preparation
activities.activity_description: Integrate all stories, run full regression suites across CI environments, finalize documentation updates, and prepare the software increment for release.
